reviews.review_text: The best thing I liked about the online MBA course at NMIMS was the extended course duration. Due to some issues, I dropped out for a year, but later on managed to complete my program within a span of 3 years.
For me NMIMS online MBA was up to the mark and met all my expectations. However, there is a little scope for improvement, but overall, I had a good experience.
I recently graduated from the NMIMS online MBA program, and it is a worthwhile option due to its minimal interaction with faculty and self paced learning facility.
The online MBA course at Narsee Monjee also offers career services that I liked the most, and on behalf of it, I recommend it to others too.

faqs.question: What are the admission requirements for the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management program?
faqs.answer: A valid bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks is the admission requirement for the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management program.

faqs.question: How does the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management differ from other MBA programs?
faqs.answer: The cutting-edge learning environment, career services, placement assistance, and other dedicated student services make the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management different from other MBA programs.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management course?
faqs.answer: The duration of the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management course is 2 years with a validity of up to 4 years.

faqs.question: What skills will I gain from the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management assists students in mastering the technical skills that help in solving big data finance problems.

faqs.question: Can I pursue the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management while working full-time?
faqs.answer: Yes, the flexible learning mode and extended course validity allow you to pursue the NMIMS Online MBA in Financial Management while working full-time.

data.placement_content:

They have witnessed a 40% improvement in the profile ranking of enrolled students and provide 6 months of access to relevant opportunities via job portals like Updazz, IIMJobs, and Hirist.

The career services offered under the NMIMS online MBA placement assistance are:

  • Job portal access.
  • Career coaching.
  • Practice interviews.
  • Profile development (CV guidance, LinkedIn optimization, etc).

These career services also provide AI-powered personalized recommendations to boost your profile based on company insights. The university has 500+ hiring partners with 20000+ recruiters shaping students' careers. Some of the leading hiring partners include:

  • ICICI Securities
  • Oracle
  • WIPRO BPO
  • Goldman Sachs
  • Tesco
  • Mercedes Benz

data.eligibility_content:
The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

The interested candidate must have completed a bachelor's degree with a 10+2+3 educational qualification from a recognized university.

The applicant must have scored a minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the graduation level (45% for reserved category students, SC/ST/OBC/PwD).
data.admission_steps:
To enroll in the NMIMS online MBA course, follow the below listed step-by-step admission process for a hassle-free enrollment procedure:

Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS Online and register.

Step 2. Complete the registration process to receive credentials to access the admission portal.

Step 3. Start filling out the application form with accurate information.

Step 4. Attach the supporting documents and submit the NMIMS online MBA application form.

Step 5. The university will verify the application form, documents, and fee.

Step 6. Once the verification is completed, the university will issue a "student number" and dispatch your study kit along with the activation of the student portal and LMS.

Course Details

To cater to the needs of working professionals and students willing to learn in-demand financial skills, the Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies offers a full-fledged online MBA in financial management course. The program is delivered through a 100% online learning mode and can be pursued simultaneously with full-time employment.

The NMIMS online MBA in financial management assists aspiring financial professionals in understanding the principles and concepts of finance. The course includes in-depth knowledge of the fundamentals of financial management to stand out in the cutting-edge, competitive corporate world.

The main objective of the NMIMS online MBA in financial management is to equip enrolled students with expertise in accounting, financial strategies, risk assessment, and capital investment to be market-ready for finance roles in leading MNCs or business corporations.

data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

data.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS online MBA in financial management syllabus is crafted by highly experienced and renowned industry experts to make students industry-ready financial leaders. The core curriculum is delivered through the latest ed-tech and a strong LMS (Learning Management System). The detailed course syllabus is listed below for a better course overview.

Year I

Semester I

  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics & Macro Economics
  • Organisational Behaviour
  • Marketing Management
  • Quantitative Methods – I

Semester II

  • Cost & Management Accounting
  • Human Resource Management
  • Strategic Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Legal Aspect of Business
  • Operations Management

Year II

Semester III

  • Corporate Finance
  • Research Methodology
  • Project Pre-work
  • Capital Market and Portfolio Management
  • Business Valuation
  • Financial Derivatives
  • Strategic Cost Management

Semester IV

  • Indian Ethos & Ethics
  • Corporate Sustainability
  • International Business
  • Project
  • Corporate Tax Planning
  • Investment Banking
  • International Finance
